**First public beta.** Tested on one PC (Windows 10 22H2, RTX 3080 Laptop, game version 1.102.37117). Please report results on other hardware with the [issue templates](https://github.com/j0p3s/Delta-Force-Tweaker/issues/new/choose).

### Two ways to use it
- **Web app (no download):** https://j0p3s.github.io/Delta-Force-Tweaker/ — pick your hardware, get recommended settings, edit `UserSystemSettingHD.ini` in your browser and download an NVIDIA Profile Inspector profile. Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Russian.
- **Windows script:** download `Delta-Force-Tweaker_v1.0.0-beta.cmd` below and double-click it (Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11).

### Highlights
- Hardware tier detection and two profiles: **Balanced** and **Competitive**
- Writes the settings to `UserSystemSettingHD.ini` with a warning and an automatic backup (scales verified against the in-game menu); token-protected files are never touched
- NVIDIA driver profile merged into NVIDIA's official Delta Force profile, verified and reversible
- Intro video skip, shader cache cleanup, local config backup/restore
- Windows 10/11 gaming settings (Game Mode, GPU scheduling, background recording, windowed game optimizations, power plan)

> **Warning:** Team Jade has warned that editing config files outside the game may lead to anti-cheat penalties. Writing the config file is optional and at your own risk; setting the values in the game menu is risk-free.
